messages.body: Windows first, but macos is the target too

Since you answered it, I suggest turning this open question into a stated decision: Windows ships first and macOS is a target too. I left Linux as an open question because you did not mention it. Note that macOS as a target makes the code-signing question below matter more, since Gatekeeper blocks unsigned apps.

messages.body: I suggest stating the decision instead of the question: the first release ships unsigned. I named the consequence so it stays visible next to the decision; it matches the SmartScreen and Gatekeeper risk listed above.

  first release?
proposal.after:
- Code signing: not in the first release. Installers ship unsigned, so users
  see the SmartScreen and Gatekeeper warnings described under Risks.
